_about: LitRPG and other-world: a game-like system with status windows and achievements. Designed by us. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

system_quirk: experience is shared with whoever you hate most
every skill has a hidden cost
the system is new and buggy
titles change your personality a little
the system speaks, and it has opinions
class_twist: a class that should not exist
a cook in a world of warriors
a summoner whose summons talk back
a merchant who levels by deals
a class that resets each dawn
dungeon: a tower that adds a floor each week
a dungeon that is someone's mind
a city that becomes a dungeon at night
a dungeon run by its monsters as a business
achievement_hook: a hidden achievement for sparing an enemy
a first-clear reward nobody has claimed
an achievement for dying in a funny way
a title for befriending a boss
a quest from the system itself
a reward that only appears for a party
rival_player: a guild leader who exploits beginners
a former friend with a better class
a player who knows the system's secret
an NPC who has realised they are an NPC
exploit: a skill that works on the system

cliches: the main character is secretly the strongest
the useless skill is actually overpowered
